title: START TERMID: several expired requests for one transaction and terminal become ONE task; staggered expiry; CANCEL REQID before and after expiry

scenarios.summary: three STARTs of GT12 for T001 expire while GT11 holds the terminal: one GT12 task RETRIEVEs all three, in order
INTERVAL(0) and INTERVAL(10): the first GT12 sees only ALPHA (BRAVO has not expired), a second GT12 at +10s sees BRAVO
START INTERVAL(30) REQID, then CANCEL at +10s: NORMAL, and GT12 never runs
the same START, CANCEL at +40s: the request already expired and ran at +30s, so CANCEL is NOTFND
